label: Planters Nuts market research case
text: Planters peanuts had lagging sales as consumers moved to healthier options such as almonds and pistachios. Research objectives: who should be the target market and what should Planters mean to them, and what marketing mix could reverse the decline.

label: Secondary data in the nut case
text: Secondary data: Nielsen data on market size, market share, average pricing and extent of distribution; public data on competitors' advertising spending; a competitor's conference presentation on target markets; competitors' advertising themes; publicly funded US Government research on the nutrient content of almonds, peanuts and pistachios. Output: peanuts were as nutritious as almonds and have less calories.

label: Planters primary data
text: Primary data: a quarterly brand health survey with 2000 people on awareness, perceptions of Planters quality and uniqueness, and perceptions of almonds, pistachios and peanuts on nutrition, fat content and price; in-depth interviews with a consumer at home followed by a trip to the store; a focus group with past but not current customers. Output: although peanuts were as healthy as other nuts, consumers favoured almonds and pistachios.
